title: Transitivity and faithful-flat descent of flatness for E∞-ring maps
statement_scope: Whole Lemma 1.5.13: let f: A → B and g: B → C be maps of E∞-rings. Then: (1) if f and g are flat, then g∘f is flat; (2) if g∘f is flat and g is faithfully flat, then f is flat.
